title: Making room for a shared step

captions.physics: Supporting each other through clear organisation
captions.energy: Including different wishes in shared life
captions.emotions: Feeling movement in a shared direction

meaning: Your support helps you move together when shared arrangements genuinely consider the different wishes of two people.
text: Moving together is easier when neither person has to disappear from the common decision. In the physical position of Anahata, the Emperor expresses care through organisation and responsibility for what was promised. The World in energy brings a wish to include different parts of your lives in a whole, giving each person a recognisable place. The Chariot in emotions offers a sense of coordinated movement. It feels good to see a shared task advance through both people’s participation. Tenderness can be visible in how the next step accommodates two people as well as the speed of reaching a convenient result.

Imagine preparing a short trip with different interests. One person wants to wander quietly; the other values a route chosen in advance. You divide preparations and leave some time without a programme. **Support helps you move together while keeping your differences.** Reserved time and packed belongings offer dependability, while the open interval needs no defence. A shared direction feels easier when organisation leaves room for different wishes to be heard before the journey begins.

The difficulty is including so much that the shared step becomes overloaded. Every interest must be considered, nothing missed and everything completed. Care becomes a programme without rest, while movement demands constant compliance. Closeness keeps space when something can wait for another occasion without postponement being declared a rejection of the person and their wish.
